responseText:
Folks are passing through here faster than I can keep track of, and many have left bits and bobs behind around the camp. There's probably an entire expeditions' worth of tools and weapons just lying around camp. 

See if you can find what you need around here, I'm sure there's something nearby that will suit your need.
